title: Grusch says he knows John Harrington

tellings.quote: I said, "Have you ever heard of John Harrington?" And Grush said, "Oh, I know I know John Harrington."

plain: Bryce Zable, a man who says he hosted David Grusch, a whistleblower who spoke in 2023 about secret government UFO programmes, at his house in Los Angeles, says he asked Grusch whether he had heard of a man named John Harrington. According to Zable, Grusch answered that he knew Harrington, and Zable also mentions a man named Ross Coulthart in the telling. He tells it because it links Harrington to people at the centre of the UFO disclosure push.
